title: Synthesis and Characterization of Coordination Compounds of Fe(II) and Sm(III) with a4-pytz[a4-pytz= 5-(N-acetato(4-pyridyl))tetrazole] as a Flexible Ligand

synthesis.procedure: Ka4-pytz (0.2 mmol, 0.0486 g) was dissolved in a mixed solvent of 1 mL water and 3.5 mL methanol. SmCl3·6H2O (0.1 mmol, 0.0365 g) was then added, and the mixture was refluxed at 80 °C for 1 h. After cooling to room temperature, the solution was transferred into a glass tube, diethyl ether was layered on top, and diffusion at ambient temperature for one week afforded pale-yellow crystals of 2.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux followed by layered diffusion in a glass tube
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled to room temperature, transferred to a glass tube, diethyl ether layered on top; pale-yellow crystals of 2 obtained after one week of ambient diffusion

properties.summary: Solid-state photoluminescence of 2 was measured at room temperature. Upon excitation at 370 nm, 2 shows a maximum emission at 367 nm, assigned to ligand-centered fluorescence (free Ka4-pytz emits at 371 nm under the same excitation), arising from π–π* transitions of the ligand.

measurements.name: emission maximum
measurements.conditions: solid state, room temperature, λex = 370 nm
